cards.label: What the portal does: public site, studio, typed sections, publishing, media, access, audit, newsletter and verification

items.title: A living archive
items.body: Research, people, projects, publications, news, events and crafts, prerendered, cinematic and fast.

items.title: The invisible CMS
items.body: No link points to it. Editors reach /studio by address, a shortcut or seven clicks on the footer mark.

items.title: Typed blocks, no migrations
items.body: A page is ordered, typed sections. A new block is a schema, a renderer and an editor form.

items.title: Resolved at read time
items.body: Draft, review, schedule, publish, archive. The read filters decide what is live, so a late cron leaks nothing.

items.title: Straight to storage
items.body: Signed uploads skip the server, derivatives are made once, and every picture is framed per screen size.

items.title: An access list first
items.body: Password, Google, Microsoft or Yahoo proves who you are; the master admin's list decides if you get in.

items.title: Every write, with its trail
items.body: The row, its revision and its audit entry commit together. Nothing an editor deletes is lost.

items.title: Composed in the studio
items.body: Issues are written in the studio and sent through Amazon SES from an outbox drained on a schedule.

items.title: Four layers in CI
items.body: Types and lint, route-check, a signed-in smoke run and a leak check that hunts drafts on the public site.
